limitations.note: The patch correctly holds `s3_d011` on invalid input, but it also changes two exits from `s4_d0110` to reuse the final zero, introducing overlapping matches that the original and reference implementations do not report.
The rolling-window oracle expects overlapping matches, so the exhaustive test validated the agent's assumption instead of catching the regression in post-match behavior.
